name: Convergence W / L / E / A · Fire
primary:
A projectile flies in an arc where you look and strikes the first target. Effects:
• Damage 2.25 ❤ lightning + 2.25 ❤ earth + 2.25 ❤ arcane + 2 ❤ fire (lightning ×2 on wet, fire ×0.5 on wet, earth ×2 on frozen)
• Soaked for 12 s and leaves a puddle
• Light push
• Charge 63: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 8 targets in a row, jumps up to 6 blocks, 2.25 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
• Knockback
• Breaks up to 8 blocks within 0.72 blocks (twice as many if brittle)
• Arcane instability: −0.25 ❤ every 2 s for 6.75 s
• Rooted in place for 3 s
• Heat: sets on fire for 13.5 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
self_description:
